about: Quest indicator copy and layout. Objective lines, the edge compass, the ground beacon and the minimap pip all read from here. The compass pointer shape and size are in 'pointer'.

lines.done: The rift stone in Ashgate is warm

layer.about: The distance/direction pill keeps its edge placement but paints under every HUD control (skill arc, Strike, belts, joystick, dock, orbs, mute) so skills stay visible and tappable when the pill overlaps them. pointer-events is none; taps pass through.

pointer.about: v84g edge-compass mark. A long, narrow arrowhead with a short tail, rotated toward the target. Sizes in CSS px. 0 rad points right (positive x), matching atan2.

hud._doc: v84m2 top-left HUD look (js/ab-questui.js turns this into CSS). strip = hero panel: one slim translucent strip, line 1 level + name + gold, line 2 zone name with a small muted count, thin XP line. quest = the quest tracker under it: smaller text and padding, light border, at most `lines` lines; `hit` px of extra invisible tap area keep it easy to tap. left/top are added to the safe-area insets (Dynamic Island).
